title: RFA — 위성사진으로 확인된 러-북 두만강 교량 완공 임박: 6/19 개통 예정, 일일 300대·2,850명 통행 가능, 러 교통부 발표, 양측 세관시설 건설 완료
snippet: Satellite imagery has revealed that North Korea and Russia are scrambling to complete a new high-capacity road bridge across their Tumen River border. The Russian Embassy in Pyongyang announced the bridge would be completed on June 19 — six months ahead of its original completion date. The new bridge will be capable of handling up to 300 vehicles and transporting 2,850 people across the border per day, according to Russia's Ministry of Transport. Construction of the North Korean customs building, roof structures, and surrounding access roads appears to have been completed or is in its final stages. On the Russian side, construction of a large-scale customs complex has advanced rapidly. Russian state media estimates the total cost at over 9 billion roubles (~$120M).
tag_reason: 이전 7일 소스에 두만강 교량 위성사진 분석 기사 없음. 6/19 개통 예정, 일일 통행량 등 구체적 수치가 새롭게 확인된 정보. 5/20 보고서에서 '6월 19일 개통 예정'을 예고 사항으로 언급했으나, 위성사진 기반 건설 완료 확인과 세부 통행량 정보는 신규.
